title: What Is Rhetoric? — Study Hall Writing Composition #10
skills: define rhetoric and its role in communication
analyze how writers adapt messages for audience and purpose
identify rhetorical choices in written and spoken texts
apply rhetorical awareness to academic and persuasive writing
alignment_note: Introduces rhetoric as the strategic use of language to communicate effectively with particular audiences and purposes. Supports rhetorical analysis, persuasive writing, audience awareness, author's purpose, and composition skills across high school English courses.
